frontHow: The ground plan marks the entrance with a black arrow at the bottom edge, pointing at the recessed door of room 1.1, and the garage door opening is in the bottom wall of the garage 1.8; the front elevation shows the door and the garage gate.

overall.includes: Width takes in the two-storey main body and the single-storey garage attached on the right. Depth is the main body from rear wall to front wall; the garage is shorter and lies inside it. The front entrance terrace (1.9) and the rear terrace (1.10) are not included.

outlineNote: A near-square two-storey main body with a small entrance recess in the front wall, and a narrower single-storey garage attached to the right wall, set back from both the front and the rear walls of the main body.

bodies.name: main
bodies.position: the left part of the front, about 9.3 of the 13.0 width

bodies.name: garage
bodies.position: attached to the right wall of the main body, set back at front and rear

uncertain: Page text gives 'Wysokosc kalenicy 9,21 m'; the section prints ridge +8,91 and terrain -0,30, so the page figure is the ridge above terrain and is used as the building height.

REAR ground count of 3 = garage slot window, the narrow glazed door/window of room 1.5 and the large living-room glazing counted as ONE opening (the plan draws one continuous opening with a mullion; the elevation shows two framed panels side by side, so 4 is possible). The living-room glazing wraps the rear-left corner; its left-wall part is counted under LEFT.
The two roof windows on each slope light the roof space above the full upper storey (the section shows no room there); they are counted as roof windows, not as upper openings.
Garage door position differs slightly between the plan (about 0.75-0.94 of the front) and the front elevation (about 0.78-0.97); the middle is given.
No chimney stack is drawn on any elevation or on the section; only a thin flue pipe is visible near the garage, so chimneys is given as 0.
Timber panels beside some windows are cladding/sliding shutters, not openings.
